title.rendered: Portable Cabins in North Delhi for Construction and Office Use

content.rendered:
SAMAN Portable supplies factory-built portable cabins in North Delhi for construction sites, schools, and businesses across Rohini, Pitampura, Civil Lines, Model Town, and Ashok Vihar. Each cabin is a steel-frame and insulated-panel unit dispatched from our Greater Noida factory, delivered to your site, and assembled in days rather than months. As a direct manufacturer serving India since 2009, we build to order, quote on enquiry, and back every unit with a real warranty — no middleman, no showroom markup.

Need a portable cabin for a North Delhi site? Call +91 88616 22859 or send an enquiry for a same-region quote.

What Drives the Cost of a Portable Cabin in North Delhi

A portable cabin's price depends on its size in feet, the panel type and insulation thickness, and the fittings you need — toilet, partition wall, electricals, flooring, and exterior finish. Delivery distance from our Greater Noida factory and the number of units also affect the final figure. For an accurate quote, share your size and use case and we will work it out for your site.

Because we manufacture and dispatch directly, you pay for the cabin and delivery, not for a reseller's margin. There is no fixed catalogue price for a custom unit — every quote is built around your exact requirement. Browse our portable cabin range to see the configurations we build, then request pricing for your North Delhi location.

Why North Delhi Builders and Businesses Choose Portable Cabins

Conventional masonry rooms take months, need permits, and cannot be moved. A factory-built portable cabin arrives ready, sits on minimal foundation, and can be relocated between sites. For temporary site offices, school rooms during renovation, or guard posts, this is a faster and more flexible option for North Delhi projects.

Conventional Construction

  • Extensive permits and approvals
  • Build time usually three to six months
  • High labour and material cost
  • Fixed location, hard to relocate
  • Heavy site preparation and foundation
  • Monsoon and weather delays common in Delhi

Portable Cabin from SAMAN

  • Minimal site permits for temporary use
  • Assembly typically in three to five days
  • Predictable, build-to-order cost
  • Fully relocatable between sites
  • Minimal foundation needed
  • Weatherproof steel-and-panel build for Delhi climate

Common Portable Cabin Uses Across North Delhi

Across North Delhi's worksites and institutions, the same steel-frame cabin is fitted out for very different jobs. We deliver to Rohini, Pitampura, Civil Lines, Model Town, Ashok Vihar, and surrounding areas as part of our service region.

Site Office Cabins

Site office cabins give contractors a comfortable, functional workspace right at the construction location. Units can include electrical wiring, lighting points, and a custom internal layout for project supervision and meetings.

Security Guard Rooms

Compact guard rooms give security staff a protected station with clear visibility at gates and boundaries. They can be fitted with electrical points, a window front, and an optional small toilet for longer postings.

Temporary School Rooms

Schools use insulated cabins during renovation or to add capacity. These classroom-ready units offer proper insulation, good natural light, and a layout suited to teaching while permanent rooms are built.

How SAMAN Portable Cabins Are Built

Every cabin starts with a structural steel frame fabricated to IS 2062, the Indian standard for structural steel. Walls and roof use roughly 50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels (minimum 40 kg/m³ core density) with a pre-galvanised steel skin, finished in powder-coated steel and GI roofing. This combination keeps interiors cooler in Delhi summers and seals out monsoon rain.

Weather Performance

  • Insulated panels for Delhi's heat and cold
  • Sealed, sloped roofing for monsoon rain
  • Powder-coated, UV-resistant exterior
  • Noticeably cooler inside than outside in peak summer

Built to Your Plan

  • Sizes made to fit tight North Delhi plots
  • Single units or modular layouts for expansion
  • Doors, windows, partitions and electricals to order
  • Exterior colour to match your site or brand

Quick to Deploy

  • Three to five day site assembly for standard units
  • Minimal foundation required
  • Light site preparation only
  • Electrical and plumbing points pre-fitted to spec

Delivery and Installation to North Delhi

We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory (Jalpura, 201308), which keeps North Delhi well within our core delivery region. Standard transit is about three to five days, with a default delivery charge of ₹3,000; larger or fitted units may need a longer build window before dispatch. Our team handles positioning, levelling, and final setup, and standard cabins are usually ready to use within a day or two of arriving on site.

For temporary construction-site offices, permits are usually minimal and often sit under the main construction approval. For longer-term placement in residential areas like Model Town, check local requirements first — we can advise on what is typically expected. See our office portable cabin for site-office configurations.

Why Buy Factory-Direct from SAMAN Portable

SAMAN POS India Private Limited has been serving India since 2009 and was incorporated in 2019. We are a direct manufacturer, not a reseller, so you deal with the people who build your cabin. Our manufacturing runs on an ISO 9001:2015 quality system, and we have delivered 500+ projects across India.

Every cabin carries our warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period. We also offer a 7-day return window from delivery, with return transport at the customer's cost.

Frequently Asked Questions About Portable Cabins in North Delhi


How long does delivery to North Delhi take?

We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory, so North Delhi is within our core delivery region. Standard units typically reach site in about three to five days, with installation completed in a day or two after arrival. Larger or heavily fitted cabins need a longer build window before dispatch — we confirm the exact timeline when you enquire.


What decides the price of a portable cabin?

Price depends on the cabin size in feet, the panel and insulation specification, and the fittings you choose — toilet, partition, electricals, flooring, and finish. Delivery distance and unit quantity also matter. There is no fixed catalogue price for a custom build; share your requirement and we prepare a quote for your North Delhi site.


Do you provide installation in Civil Lines and nearby areas?

Yes. We deliver and install across North Delhi, including Civil Lines, Rohini, Pitampura, Model Town, and Ashok Vihar. Our team handles delivery, positioning, levelling, and final setup. For most standard cabins, installation is finished within one to two days of the unit reaching your site.


What permits are needed for a portable cabin in North Delhi?

Requirements depend on how long the cabin stays and where it sits. For temporary site offices, permits are usually minimal and often fall under the main construction approval. For longer-term placement in residential areas, additional local permission may apply. We can guide you on what is typically expected for your location.


Can a portable cabin handle Delhi's summer heat and monsoon?

Yes. Our cabins use roughly 50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels and sealed, sloped roofing, which keep interiors noticeably cooler than the outside temperature and seal out monsoon rain. Powder-coated, UV-resistant exteriors hold up to North Delhi's seasonal extremes.


Get a Portable Cabin Quote for Your North Delhi Project

Ready to plan a portable cabin for Rohini, Pitampura, Civil Lines, Model Town, or Ashok Vihar? Tell us your size, use, and site location and we will prepare a factory-direct quote.

Talk to SAMAN Portable

Get a same-region quote for your North Delhi site, direct from the manufacturer.

Call +91 88616 22859  ·  WhatsApp +91 88616 22859
